target_customer: Consumers, especially people with deeper skin tones, with hyperpigmentation, acne, dryness and barrier problems who lack dermatologist access
problem: Skincare was mostly clinically tested on lighter skin and dermatology care is hard to reach. Lion Pose sells dermatologist developed formulas with third party clinical testing on diverse skin tones.
business_model: Direct to consumer e-commerce on Shopify plus Sephora retail

founders.name: Madhu Punjabi
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder in the July 2023 PR Newswire release; former Silicon Valley software employee; not on the YC page.

competitors.name: Topicals
competitors.what: Skincare for chronic skin conditions and hyperpigmentation, formulated and tested on diverse skin tones, founded 2019
competitors.traction_then: Selected for Sephora Accelerate and reached Sephora about six months after its DTC launch (Refinery29, ties to 2021)

technical_complexity.rationale: Formulation by contract manufacturers and dermatologists, clinical testing and e-commerce; no novel technology.

defensibility.rationale: Clinical testing claims and Sephora placement help, but formulas and positioning are copyable by many skincare brands.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows copying or acquisition of Lion Pose.

market_need_then: Brands were promoting inclusivity while diverse skin testing was rare (Topicals founder quoted by Refinery29). Sephora Accelerate in 2021 focused on BIPOC owned brands.

branding.name_origin: Beauty Matter profile (via search) says the name refers to the lion pose in yoga that encourages finding your voice; this is the brand's own account

identity.logo: Orange and white logo versions; design not described
identity.mascot_or_character: Lion motif implied by name; not confirmed
identity.visual_style: Orange palette, clinical but playful product names such as Pep Talk, Unspotted, Unghosted
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, confident and somewhat contrarian toward competitors, stressing clinical testing and dermatology access

branding.brand_signature: Playful product names and a celebrity investor and ambassador, Mindy Kaling
branding.community_and_virality: Site lists features on GMA, Today, Shark Tank and Oprah (self-reported); Mindy Kaling is an investor and ambassador (press release).

brand_strength.rationale: Celebrity backing, Sephora launch and a memorable naming style, but little independent evidence of a driving community.

outcome_analysis: Lion Pose went through YC W21 and Sephora Accelerate, launched at Sephora in July 2023 with a 3 million dollar seed backed by Mindy Kaling and others, and remains a small independent brand selling online and at Sephora. No later round, shutdown or acquisition was found.
notes: The 3M seed is from the company press release and repeated by FashionUnited and BeautyMatter via search; some databases list 3.13M total. Press release names dermatologists Dr. Laura Scott and Dr. Tia Paul while the site names three medical board members; not reconciled. The Topicals source date is approximate from a search summary. Founding year 2021 per YC; prior funding before 2023 not found.
